description:
Thank you for being a blessing in my life ❤️

Te amo and Happy Valentine’s Day @marthahigareda  From: Your Husband 💍🙂

#love #valentines #wedding #mexico #mexicowedding #amor
transcript: But courage to me is the quality that I think is one of the hardest to have. You can be born with beauty, you can be born with talent in certain things, but courage I think you have to develop over time. So that was one of my first words for you, and I just think you're a beautiful, courageous woman. Loving was something that I don't think I've ever fully felt, fully felt accepted and loved by someone. So loving was something that I said as well. And the third thing was pure. Not perfect, but pure. Martha is just a blessing in my life. And I'm so grateful that God has brought you to me. And even though it took almost 40 years to meet you, it was worth the wait. So I love you. I'm grateful for you. And thank you for being a blessing in my life.
